proposed_value: The MPRA library was sequenced using STARR-seq, where both RNA and input DNA libraries were sequenced to depths of at least 2.6 billion and 470 million reads, respectively, to associate barcodes with sequences before delivery to cells.
rationale: - The paper states: 'We focused our analysis on the 604,268 enhancer-promoter pairs for which we obtained good coverage (Methods). STARR-seq expression (RNA/DNA) varied over six orders of magnitude and was highly reproducible when comparing the following expression values: individual plasmid barcodes between biological replicates (R² = 0.92; Fig. 1b and Extended Data Fig. 1b); an enhancer-promoter pair averaged across plasmid barcodes between biological replicates (R² = 0.92); and different plasmid barcodes for a given enhancer-promoter pair (R² = 0.62; Extended Data Fig. 1d-f and Methods).'
calculation: The sequencing depth for RNA and DNA libraries is explicitly stated as at least 2.6 billion and 470 million reads, respectively, which supports the procedural description of sequencing to associate barcodes with sequences.
